svg.text: Head: semi-realistic caricature, fine wrinkle lines,
flat skin tone, 9px outline at 1000px head scale.
Body: solid black stick lines, no hands, no clothes.
Torso 30px, arms 26px, legs 28px. Always pure black.
Top hat = logo/branding only, tilted ~6° left.
Default face: deadpan, half-lidded, flat mouth.
Freckles: 4 per cheek. Light stubble on jaw.
In episodes, headwear fits class and scene: poor
= worn flat cap outdoors; never a hat indoors,
in bed or in hospital. Watch stays his symbol.
Violence: X-eyes, sweat, tears. Never gore.
Bottom-right of every frame kept clear for watermark.
